titulo: The moon went from nothing to half in eight days
caption:
The moon went from nothing to half in eight days

Tuesday night the moon is exactly half lit (first quarter, 50%).

Eight days ago it was a new moon, invisible. Look up after sunset, and finish something.

alt: A short film with no voice. A night patio under a blue sky with stars. Two small block figures with white eyes, one amber and one light blue, look up at the moon. Over ten seconds the moon grows from a thin sliver to exactly half a disc, lit on the right, as if eight days passed. Their eyes narrow, then go wide when it reaches half, then smile. The text stays: if this found you: the moon went from nothing to half in eight days. Finish something.
